title: Automated Traffic Violation Enforcement System with Direct Fine Deduction.
situation: Automated Traffic Violation Enforcement System with Direct Fine Deduction.
entities: 1. Vehicles: The vehicles moving through the monitored intersections. 2. Traffic Management Infrastructure: This includes cameras, sensors, and the central control unit re- sponsible for monitoring and processing traffic violations. 3. Traffic Management Authorities 4. Banking System: The system responsible for handling financial transactions and deducting fines from the bank accounts of violators.
communication_type: Vehicle to Infrastructure, Infrastructure to Infrastructure
description: The intelligent traffic management system is designed to automatically detect vehicles that break traffic signals and deduct fines directly from their bank accounts. This system utilizes a network of cameras and sensors installed at key intersections to monitor traffic flow and identify violations in real-time. When a vehicle is detected running a red light or violating any other traffic signal, the system captures relevant information such as the vehicle’s license plate number, timestamp, and the nature of the violation. This information is then processed by a central control unit which interfaces with the banking system to initiate the fine deduction process.
